name: AISuggestion
summary: Inline AI proposal card. Left-edge accent stroke + Sparkles glyph + suggestion body + accept/reject IconButtons. Used inside RTE inline suggestions, AI-rewrite cards, AI-summary previews. Distinct from CitationCard (the source) and AIBadge (the inline 'AI generated' label).

rules: role='complementary' or role='note' depending on context.
Sparkles glyph + 'AI suggestion' eyebrow label so SR users hear it's an AI proposal.
Accept / Reject have explicit aria-labels ('Accept rewrite', 'Dismiss suggestion').
When dismissed, replace the AISuggestion with a Toast or sr-only confirmation.

do: Lead the card with a Sparkles glyph + 'AI suggestion' eyebrow label.
Left-edge 2 px text.accent stroke for visual distinction.
Pair with CitationCard when the suggestion references a source.
Accept = intent='ai' button (small); Reject = intent='ghost' or IconButton.
dont: Don't autopapy-accept after a timeout — the user must take action.
Don't render AI suggestions in destructive flows without explicit confirmation.
Don't paint the entire card in lime — left-edge stroke + tint surface only.
